What Are The Top 10 Highest-Grossing Movies Of 2024?
By
Tim Lammers
,
Contributor.
Forbes contributors publish independent expert analyses and insights.
I cover Hollywood and entertainment.

Winona Ryder and Michael Keaton in "Beetlejuice Beetlejuice."
Warner Bros. Pictures/Parisa Taghizadeh
Inside Out 2, Moana 2,
Deadpool & Wolverine
and
Wicked
were among the biggest winners at the 2024 box office, but what other films made big money this year?
As list shows, sequels drew the biggest audiences in 2024. Of the top 10 highest-grossing films listed by
Box Office Mojo
, nine were sequels and the other was a prequel.
The tallies for each of the films are through last weekend of the calendar year, Dec. 27-29.  In addition, streaming information accompanies each of the listings.
Here’s a breakdown of the top 10 highest-grossing films in descending at the worldwide box office in 2024.
10: ‘Beetlejuice Beetlejuice’ - $451.1 Million Worldwide
Beetlejuice Beetlejuice
—director Tim Burton’s long-awaited sequel to the 1988 supernatural comedy classic
Beetlejuice
starring
Michael Keaton
, Winona Ryder and Catherine O’Hara—was released in theaters domestically by Warner Bros. on Sept. 6.
Forbes

By
Tim Lammers
MORE FOR YOU
Also starring Jenna Ortega, Monica Bellucci, Justin Theroux, Willem Dafoe and
Danny DeVito
,
Beetlejuice Beetlejuice
earned $294.1 million domestically and $157 million internationally for a worldwide box office gross of $451 million.
Domestic box office ranking:
No. 6.
Streaming:
Beetlejuice Beetlejuice
is streaming on Max.
9: ‘Venom: The Last Dance’ - $476.3 Million Worldwide
The third and presumably final film in Sony Pictures Entertainment’s
Venom
trilogy starring Tom Hardy as Eddie Brock/Venom was released in theaters domestically on Oct. 25.
Also starring Juno Temple, Chiwetel Ejiofor, Rhys Ifans and Stephen Graham,
Venom: The Last Dance
earned $139.7 million at the domestic box office and $336.6 million internationally.
Domestic box office ranking:
No. 16.
Streaming:
Venom: The Last Dance
is streaming
on video on demand
on various digital platforms.
8: ‘Kung Fu Panda 4’ - $547.6 Million Worldwide
Kung Fu Panda 4
—starring the voices of Jack Black and Awkwafina—was released in North American theaters by Universal Pictures on March 8.
Also starring the voices of Bryan Cranston and Viola Davis,
Kung Fu Panda 4
earned nearly $193.6 million domestically and $354 million internationally.
Domestic box office ranking:
No. 10.
Streaming:
Kung Fu Panda 4
is streaming on Netflix.
7: ‘Godzilla X Kong: The New Empire’ - $571.7 Million Worldwide
The fifth chapter in Warner Bros.’ MonsterVerse shared movie universe,
Godzilla x Kong: The New Empire
was released in theaters domestically on March 29.
Starring Rebecca Hall, Dan Stevens and Brian Tyree Henry,
Godzilla x Kong: The New Empire
earned $196.3 million domestically and $375.4 million internationally.
Forbes

By
Tim Lammers
Domestic box office ranking:
No. 9.
Streaming:
Godzilla x Kong: The New Empire
is streaming on Max and Netflix.
6. ‘Wicked’ - $634.3 Million Worldwide
Wicked
—a prequel to
The Wizard of Oz
—is the only non-sequel on the list of the top 10 highest-grossing films of 2024.
Wicked
was released in theaters domestically on Nov. 22.
Forbes
‘Wicked’ Arrives On Digital Streaming This Week With Bonus Features
By
Tim Lammers
Directed by Jon M. Chu and starring Cynthia Erivo and Ariana Grande, Universal Pictures’
Wicked
has grossed $424.2 million domestically and $210.1 million internationally through Dec. 29.
Domestic box office ranking:
No. 3.
Streaming:
Wicked
is streaming
on video on demand
on various digital platforms.
5: ‘Dune: Part Two’ - $714.4 Million Worldwide
Before he channeled Bob Dylan in
A Complete Unknown
,
Timothée Chalamet
took a trip back to Arrakis on March 1 for the Warner Bros. sequel to director Denis Villeneuve’s 2021 hit,
Dune
.

Also starring Zendaya, Rebecca Ferguson, Javier Bardem and Josh Brolin,
Dune: Part Two
grossed $282.1 million domestically and $432.3 million internationally.
Domestic box office ranking:
No. 7.

Dune: Part Two

4: ‘Moana 2’ - $882.5 Million Worldwide
Auli'i Cravalho and Dwayne “The Rock” Johnson return as the voices of Moana and Maui in the sequel to Disney’s 2016 animated blockbuster
Moana
.
Released in theaters on Nov. 27,
Moana 2
has grossed $394.6 domestically and $487.9 million internationally to date.
Domestic box office ranking:
No. 3.
Streaming:
Moana 2
is only playing in theaters.
3: ‘Despicable Me 4’ - $969.1 Million Worldwide
The sixth film in the
Despicable Me
franchise—which includes two
Minions
films—was released in theaters domestically on July 3.
Starring the voices of Steve Carell, Kristin Wiig, Will Ferrell and Pierre Coffin (as the Minions),
Despicable Me 4
gross $361 million domestically and $608.1 million internationally.
Domestic box office ranking:
No. 5.
Streaming:
Despicable Me 4
is streaming on Peacock.
2. Deadpool & Wolverine - $1.338 Billion Worldwide
The third movie in Ryan Reynolds’
Deadpool
movie series marks the character’s introduction to Disney’s Marvel Cinematic Universe via the company’s 20th Century Studios banner.
Released in theaters domestically on July 26, the former 20th Century Fox antihero Deadpool is joined by Fox’s former
X-Men
superhero Wolverine (Hugh Jackman) and a slew of other characters from Fox’s Marvel films in supporting and cameo roles.

Kelsey Mann
(born November 16, 1974) is an American film director and storyboard artist. He is best known for directing the
Pixar
animated film
Inside Out 2
(2024), which earned him an
Academy Award
nomination for the
Best Animated Feature
.
[
1
]
Early life and education
[
edit
]
Mann graduated from
Burnsville High School
in 1993. He went on to attend
Northern Michigan University
, where he earned a
Bachelor of Fine Arts
illustration in 1998.
[
2
]
[
3
]
Career
[
edit
]
Mann started his career at
Cartoon Network
, where he worked as a storyboard artist on
Duck Dodgers
,
Megas XLR
,
My Gym Partner's a Monkey
,
Foster's Home for Imaginary Friends
, and
Star Wars: The Clone Wars
, before joining
Pixar
in 2009,
[
4
]
where he started as a story supervisor for
Monsters University
,
The Good Dinosaur
(also co-wrote the story for the film), and
Onward
.
[
5
]
[
6
]
He made his directorial debut with the short film
Party Central
, which he also wrote, taking place shortly after
Monsters University
.
[
7
]
In September 2022, during the
D23 Expo
announcement, Mann was announced to direct the feature film
Inside Out 2
, which serves as the sequel to the 2015 film
Inside Out
, taking over for
Pete Docter
, who is instead the executive producer of the film, which was released on June 14, 2024.
